components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary call-to-action with a teal background.
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 24px; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; border: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta-primary { background: #075973; color: #ffffff; } .ds-cta-primary:hover { background: #054258; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Pill-shaped secondary call-to-action with a teal border and transparent background.
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 24px; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: none; border: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta-outline { background: transparent; color: #075973; border-color: #075973; } .ds-cta-outline:hover { background: #f5f8fa; }

components.name: Founder Focus Chip
components.description: A tonal pill-shaped tag used for founder focus areas.
components.css: .ds-focus-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { font-size: 14px; color: #5b6b80; background: #f5f8fa; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Founder Card

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; border: 1px solid #d5dfe7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 32px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Libre Caslon Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 26px; color: #121d36; margin: 0; font-weight: 400; } .ds-card-role { color: #234b82; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; margin: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { color: #43516b; font-size: 18px; margin: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Inline text navigation with a 2px teal bottom border for active state.

narrative.overview:
The visual identity is a cool white architecture atlas, prioritizing clarity, legibility, and engineering rigor. The system uses a navy serif headline with blue emphasis to anchor technical content, complemented by teal pill actions that guide the user through walkthroughs and architecture decisions.

Density is deliberate. Ample whitespace and strict container boundaries prevent technical diagrams and code-heavy text from becoming overwhelming. The Founders section inherits this design; it currently lists Michael Lvov alone, with Alla to be added later. Profiles are data-driven.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white and navy palette with teal emphasis
Serif headlines paired with highly legible sans-serif body text
Flat aesthetic with tonal layering for depth

rules.name: The Atlas Rule
rules.body: The UI maintains a cool, calm atlas aesthetic. Avoid warm colors or high-saturation accents outside the established Teal and Muted Blue.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows are only used for floating elements (like mobile dropdowns) and never for cards or primary buttons.

dos: Do use pill shapes (999px radius) for all primary and secondary call-to-action buttons.
Do frame diagrams and architecture figures with a 1px Light Border and 8px radius.
Do use the `mailto:` contact convention for founder inquiries.
donts: Don't apply drop shadows to cards or buttons; use tonal layering (`Cool Paper`) for depth.
Don't include credentials or private model routes in project documentation.
Don't invent primary navigation links outside the established Architecture, Walkthroughs, Decisions, and Founders routes.
